blocks.text: Following the successful mounting of its youth-oriented programs in Metro Manila, SM through its sustainability arm and SM Cares reinforced its commitment to empower community opportunities through the youth, as well as enhance their agency to care for the environment with the third annual Sustainability Summit. Mounted in partnership with the Department of Science and Technology, the Department of Agriculture, the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, as well as the Region I offices of the Commission on Higher Education and the Department of Trade and Industry, the summit aims to encourage scientific research and innovation among local students at their […]...
